name: Portugal

flag.description: A vertical bicolor of green at the hoist (two-fifths) and red (three-fifths), with the national arms on a yellow armillary sphere centered on the dividing line.
flag.symbolism: Green is commonly said to stand for hope and red for the blood of those who died for the nation; the armillary sphere honors the Age of Discovery.

hook: Portugal splits green and red unevenly and pins a navigator's armillary sphere on the seam, a reminder of its seafaring explorers.
trivia: The flag was adopted in 1911, after the monarchy was overthrown in 1910.
The shield carries seven castles and five small blue shields called 'quinas'.
